vigilant_raptor_totem.summary: A stylized toy raptor bust built from faceted bone-white and black planes with a vivid mint eye and bright yellow hooked bill.
vigilant_raptor_totem.pose: Carved stone eagle bust gazing rigidly due west with a heavy furrowed brow and cantilevered yellow beak.

bristle_shingle_stack.summary: A tiered stack of thin, angled grey slate shingles mimicking coarse dry-brush feathering dragged upward.

cantilever_perch.summary: A tapered yellow-gold sandstone prow jutting outward like a stylized hooked bill over the lower cliff.

quill_spire_marker.summary: A sharp, multi-sided quill spire of dense dark charcoal slate with a faceted yellow ochre base band.

things.text: A bone-pale shale feather, scoured smooth by the west wind.
